class: Copied domain branding overrides employer identity
symptom: An unrelated domain in a page title was recorded as the employer, including a trailing dot.
root_cause: Domain-shaped site metadata was treated as a human company name without checking the page address.
why_tests_missed: The existing copied-title regression failed on the base branch; matching-domain and tenant cases were missing.
fix: Require domain branding to match the host or employer tenant and normalize it through URL identity.
prevention: Cross-check domain identity against the source address and retain ordinary human company metadata.
